objective: Activate one approved R-Code WorkUnit safely in the current checkout and prove edit, verification, review and CAS rollback end to end.
end_state: After exact plan approval, one WorkUnit can execute only within its approved paths, every mutation has a durable before/after journal, required checks bind host evidence to the candidate, successful work reaches ReviewReady, and accept or reject completes without overwriting later user edits.
non_goals: Git index, commit, push, ref or submodule writes

environment.notes: Continue on the dirty P-GATE baseline. Use snapshots, no commits or pushes, and preserve the two declared baseline failures.

components.name: Durable path ownership
components.description: Approved logical/physical path scopes with fencing and recovery.

components.name: Mutation journal
components.description: Prepared/applied/receipted file effects with CAS before-images.

components.name: Sequential WorkUnit execution
components.description: One approved unit dispatched with an Execution RunSnapshot.

components.name: Review and rollback
components.description: ReviewReady acceptance, rejection and explicit Unverified override.

tasks.title: Persist authorized path leases and mutation operations
tasks.description: Define approved WorkUnit effect scopes and durable lease/operation records with logical and physical path identity.

files.what: Add additive WorkUnit read/write/effect scopes.
Carry approved effect scopes into WorkUnits.
Validate canonical effect paths before hashing a PlanRevision.
Resolve logical and physical path identities.
Enable target-specific filesystem identity APIs.
Add durable leases and mutation operation tables.
Implement fenced lease and operation repositories.
Expose mutation persistence.
Populate effect defaults in legacy plan adapters.
Populate additive effect scopes in generated WorkUnits.

subtasks.description: Normalize approved read/write paths and validate WorkUnit scopes inside the checkout.
Acquire/release durable shared, exclusive and repository leases with monotonic fencing epochs.
Persist Prepared, Applied and Receipted operations plus before/after SHA-256 and CAS blobs.

tests.description: Path alias, traversal, symlink/junction and nonexistent-output parent identities fail closed.
Lease conflict, stale fencing, restart and idempotent operation replay are deterministic.

acceptance_criteria: A lease can never authorize a path outside the exact approved Plan scope.
Every mutation operation has one durable ownership epoch and recoverable state.
Stale owners cannot complete or receipt newer operations.

tasks.title: Execute mediated file mutations through the journal
tasks.description: Expose approved create/edit/delete/apply-patch tools rooted at the current checkout and record CAS-safe deltas.

files.what: Carry attempt-stable operation keys into ToolService calls.
Persist indeterminate receipts and reconcile mediated tool retries.
Build an execution ToolService bound to approved paths.
Coordinate leases, before-images, file effects and receipts.
Resolve durable CAS references used by mutation recovery.
Expose mutation execution.
Select execution tools only for an approved Execution snapshot.
Persist intended before/after identities before file effects.
Submit Implementation proposals for execution runs.

subtasks.description: Resolve the approved WorkUnit and acquire its write leases before tool discovery.
Journal before-images before each mediated file effect and persist measured after-images.
Reconcile Applied-without-Receipt operations without repeating their effects.

tests.description: Approved edits succeed; out-of-scope and guessed writes are denied before touching disk.
Fault injection at every operation boundary recovers without duplicate writes.
Concurrent external edits create Conflict and are never overwritten.

acceptance_criteria: Every file write is mediated by the durable mutation journal.
The current checkout is the only writable root.
Git metadata and unapproved ignored files remain unwritable.

tasks.title: Dispatch one WorkUnit and bind verification evidence
tasks.description: Create an Execution RunSnapshot from the active approval, run one dependency-ready WorkUnit, capture its Candidate and execute required host checks.

files.what: Dispatch one approved unit and build an Execution snapshot.
Project Verifying and RepairRequired task phases.
Expose bounded confirmation that the main Harness process exited before Candidate verification can proceed.
Build approval-bound Execution snapshots with WorkUnit identity.
Capture post-mutation candidates for verification.
Produce complete candidate/environment-bound evidence.
Separate immutable check definitions from evidence rows.
Apply idempotent additive verification migrations when opening an existing v1 store.
Revalidate that an Execution/Repair snapshot names a WorkUnit in the exact currently approved Plan inside the persistence transaction.
Persist definitions and immutable evidence separately.
Transition through Verifying and RepairRequired.
Mechanically populate the additive Evidence identity fields in the existing conformance fixture.

subtasks.description: Choose exactly one dependency-ready WorkUnit and mark its attempt durable.
Capture the post-mutation CandidateManifest and invalidate evidence on drift.
Run required definitions, persist Evidence and classify pass/fail/unavailable.

tests.description: Approved execution survives daemon restart and never dispatches twice.
Passed checks reach ReviewReady; failed or unavailable checks reach RepairRequired.
Candidate or input drift makes evidence stale.

acceptance_criteria: Execution snapshots always reference the active exact plan approval.
Required checks are host-owned and bound to candidate plus environment.
ReviewReady is impossible while checks or descendant processes remain active.

tasks.title: Complete ReviewReady acceptance and CAS rollback
tasks.description: Expose candidate changes and evidence, accept verified work, reject through CAS rollback, and audit explicit Unverified acceptance.

files.what: Use SHA-256 and durable mutation records for review/rollback.
Expose review get, accept, reject and Unverified override.
Add daemon review RPCs.
Mechanically project the additive VerifiedAccepted and UnverifiedAccepted terminal verdict labels.
Bind Candidate identity and live revalidation to stable physical file identities so same-byte alias replacement is stale.
Enumerate exact-attempt Mutation Journal operations in stable order for Review projection and reverse CAS rollback.
Finalize VerifiedAccepted or audited UnverifiedAccepted.

subtasks.description: Project WorkUnit-owned diffs, Candidate identity and verification evidence.
Accept verified candidate without Git mutation.
Reject by CAS rollback or surface Conflict; persist Unverified actor/reason/check list.

tests.description: Edit, check, ReviewReady and accept completes VerifiedAccepted without commit.
Reject restores only unchanged agent after-images and preserves later user edits.
Unverified override requires actor, reason and failed/missing checks and is immutable.

acceptance_criteria: M-GATE is deterministic with a fake Provider and one WorkUnit.
Rollback never overwrites bytes that no longer match the recorded after hash.
No review action stages, commits, pushes or modifies Git refs.
